name: Benny Gantz
role: Israeli defense minister (2020–2022), former IDF chief and Blue and White leader
summary: Gantz combines Jewish national statehood and an assertive security strategy with competitive markets, public services and constitutional checks. He supports civil marriage recognition and regional alliances while opposing unconditional Palestinian statehood.
